what_we_know: Context selection/policy layer is useful — SDI auto policy improved win/tie rate to 7/8
Swap death is avoidable with active memory guards in tested ranges
0.5B failures are often model capability ceilings, not policy failures
3B is a stronger local eval model for SDI quality validation
External Ollama telemetry cannot directly expose KV cache behavior
Deep KV instrumentation not justified by current data
Time-per-token scales linearly and predictably with context
c=8192 works reliably across 0.5B, 3B, and 7B on this machine
what_we_dont_know: Exact KV cache allocation behavior inside Ollama backend
Broad 7B task behavior across many different task types
Speed/throughput improvements with SDI vs without
Whether context pressure manifests differently on different hardware
Optimal context selection policy for arbitrary user conversations
pause_rationale: SDI v0.1.1 has complete documented story. Probing produced null result on memory cliffs. Diminishing returns without new hypothesis.
allowed_claims: SDI v0.1.1 is a documented standalone context-selection prototype
Bounded 7B probes passed WS-512 through WS-6144 under strict guard
No swap/RAM cliff found in tested bounded ranges
Deep KV instrumentation not justified by current data
